title: Update-half parity with lore-cli LCLI-593: not-run reasons, Codex detail by progress, and an update-timeout override
description: QCLI-371 AC4 update-half parity read, 2026-09-26, against lore-cli LCLI-593 (opum-ai/lore-cli#297, merged 46133fc0, an ancestor of lore-cli dev), files src/core/agent-plugins.ts and src/adapters/agent-plugins.ts read by ref. The core mechanism MATCHES quest: the update runs only when installed and the runtime is named; Claude is scoped; Codex runs marketplace upgrade then add; update/updateOk/updateDetail; a failed update keeps its remedy; nothing is ever installed or enabled. lore is AHEAD in three observable ways. (1) Every not-run report carries updateDetail naming why: no runtime named (and the --target command that would), disabled (never enabled), not-installed (never installed), or unreadable. quest not-run reports carry no updateDetail. (2) The Codex detail is worded by how far the update got, via an outcome.completed step count. The all-plugins CODEX_MARKETPLACE_NOTICE is appended only when the marketplace upgrade succeeded; when the upgrade succeeded and the re-add failed, the detail says the marketplace-wide refresh already happened (ruling 25: say the side effect where it happens). quest has one fixed success sentence and on a partial failure says only the failure. (3) LORE_AGENT_PLUGINS_UPDATE_TIMEOUT_MS overrides the 600s per-step update deadline, separately from the list deadline. Also structural, not observable: lorePluginUpdateSteps is the single source for both the argv run and the command printed. The unnamable-scope defect is filed separately, as a ruling violation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every update not-run report carries an updateDetail whose text matches lore-cli 46133fc0 notRunDetail with lore agents --target/--force replaced by quest agents --update-instructions --target

The Codex update detail follows lore-cli codexUpdateDetail: the all-plugins notice only after the marketplace upgrade succeeded, and the already-refreshed wording when the re-add then fails; tests cover upgrade-fails, add-fails and both-succeed
QUEST_AGENT_PLUGINS_UPDATE_TIMEOUT_MS overrides the per-step update deadline independently of the list deadline
One function yields both the update argv and the printed update command; bun run check exits 0; cited against lore-cli 46133fc0
